name: GitHub issue webhook → Slack
description: Receives a GitHub issue webhook (point the repo's webhook at the daemon's /trigger endpoint with the per-flow secret), renders the payload into one Slack line, and posts it to your triage channel. render_text turns the issue row into the message string that Slack's body expects.

params.template: '[' + row.repository.full_name + '] #' + string(row.issue.number) + ' ' + row.action + ' by ' + row.sender.login + ': ' + row.issue.title
